title: Algorithm: Exponential Backoff Network Retry
description:
Real-World Algorithm: Exponential Backoff Network Retry
When cloud servers fail to connect, network clients double their waiting delay on each retry (1s, 2s, 4s, 8s) until a maximum retry count is reached.

The Challenge:
The retry setup below is locked. In the editable section, write a while loop that runs while attempt <= 3:
- Multiply delay = delay * 2
- Increment attempt = attempt + 1
